editorial:
Picture the worst day of your life looping back on itself every time things go wrong. That is the wild ride you get with this teen comedy. You follow Rob, a high school senior who just wants to make it through one big day without messing up. Instead, every time he fails at losing his virginity, the clock resets and he has to start all over. It is silly, awkward, and surprisingly sweet, with a fast pace that keeps you laughing. The vibe feels like a mix of classic teen comedies and time-loop stories, but with its own goofy charm.

The acting is energetic and the jokes land more often than not. Some scenes push the awkward humor a little too far, and a few side characters feel thin. Still, the heart of the story keeps you invested. If you enjoy raunchy but good-natured comedies, this one is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final loop, Rob stops chasing the perfect moment and focuses on being honest with the people he cares about. He finally tells his crush how he really feels and makes peace with his friends. The loop breaks when he chooses connection over conquest. The last scene shows him waking up to a normal day, relieved and changed, ready to move forward without repeating his mistakes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen comedies with a time-loop twist.
